searchEvidence: smoke-release.ps1 now has the owner-approved exact v1.0.0 128 MiB exception, but create_update_catalog.py, update-catalog-v1.schema.json, and UpdateCatalogValidator still independently reject every package above 80,000,000 bytes.

terminalContract: Only stable version 1.0.0 may declare a package of 1 through 134,217,728 bytes. Every other catalog version remains limited to 1 through 80,000,000 bytes. The rule changes no application executable cap, file allowlist, digest, manifest, SBOM, provenance, or Bootstrap exclusion.
